hero.title: Dependable Healthcare Staffing in Alberta
hero.subtitle: We deliver licensed professionals ready to care from Calgary to remote northern communities, and across Canada

blocks.html:
Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment is a healthcare staffing agency committed to connecting Alberta’s healthcare facilities with reliable professionals.

Our focus is supplying qualified nurses, personal support workers, and allied health professionals who can meet the high standards residents and patients deserve.

Your facility deserves the best professionals passionate about making sure patients get the care they deserve..

Why Health Facilities Choose Us?

Healthcare in Alberta is unique. Hence, facilities must balance growing demand with limited staffing pools. Especially in rural communities and long-term care homes.

Goodwill provides staffing solutions built for this reality.

We understand the province’s healthcare system, its regional challenges, and the urgency facilities face when shifts go unfilled.

When you work with us, here’s what you gain:

  • Qualified professionals ready to step in – nurses, PSWs, and allied health staff with verified experience.
  • Flexible coverage – temporary, contract, and long-term placements.
  • Reliability – staff who arrive on time, trained, and ready to deliver safe care.
  • Streamlined process – fast response to last-minute needs.

Alberta’s long-term care homes rely on steady staffing to protect resident well-being. Goodwill places professionals who understand dementia support, palliative care, and mobility assistance.

We focus on ensuring every resident receives the level of care and dignity they deserve. And easing the burden on facilities facing shortages.

Our Alberta staffing services provide:

  • Registered Nurses (RNs) – delivering clinical expertise in hospitals, clinics, and community health.
  • Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) – offering vital support in long-term care, rehabilitation, and acute care.
  • Personal Support Workers (PSWs) – assisting with daily living, mobility, and personal comfort.

Every professional we place is screened, credentialed, and matched carefully to the environment where they’ll be most effective.

Beyond nursing, Alberta healthcare facilities often need specialized allied health professionals. Goodwill supplies qualified staff in roles such as:

  • Respiratory therapy

  • Medical laboratory services

  • Medical imaging

  • Physiotherapy and occupational therapy

  • Pharmacy support

Our goal is to keep diagnostic, therapeutic, and support services running without disruption.

Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment provides healthcare staffing across Alberta, including:

Calgary and Edmonton – hospitals, clinics, and large facilities facing high demand.

Smaller urban centres such as Red Deer, Lethbridge, and Medicine Hat.

Rural and remote communities where staffing shortages are most severe.

Wherever your facility is located, we help ensure staffing challenges never compromise patient care.

blocks.text: Why Work With Goodwill in Alberta?

blocks.html:
Facilities choose us because we provide stability. Our process is built around:

  • Thorough vetting – every candidate is qualified, experienced, and reference-checked.
  • Speed and flexibility – we respond quickly when you need coverage.
  • Local knowledge – we understand Alberta’s healthcare system and staffing requirements.
  • Commitment to care – we supply professionals who share the values of compassion, safety, and respect.

Healthcare leaders across Alberta face the same challenge. And this includes filling critical shifts without sacrificing care quality.

Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment is here to help. We specialize in connecting facilities with professionals who can step in, adapt, and deliver the care patients and residents depend on.

items.title: We match you with qualified professionals

items.question: Are your staff licensed to work in Alberta?
items.answer: Yes. All staff are licensed with NSCN or their appropriate regulatory body and meet the province’s practice standards.

items.question: Can you provide support to long-term care and hospitals?
items.answer: Absolutely. We support Alberta Health facilities, LTC homes, private clinics, and group homes across the province.

items.question: Do you offer mental health or addictions-trained staff?
items.answer: Yes. We have a roster of professionals with training in trauma-informed care, harm reduction, and behavioral support for mental health and addictions programs.

items.question: Do you support placements outside major cities?
items.answer: Yes. We staff healthcare professionals in rural and coastal regions, including Calgary, Edmonton, Red Deer, and Lethbridge.
